global_direction.style_consistency: 整套画面保持 premium skincare 的极简高级风格，统一使用柔光、奶油白与浅香槟金色系，版式留白充足。
global_direction.product_consistency: 所有画面中的瓶身比例、标签信息、瓶盖材质与主色调需保持一致，不可擅自改动包装结构或品牌元素。
global_direction.render_quality: 高真实感商业级渲染，标签清晰、材质准确、玻璃与油体反射自然，适合电商A+详情页使用。
global_direction.negative_prompt: low resolution, blurry label, distorted bottle, extra objects, messy composition, harsh shadows, medical symbols, before after collage, exaggerated claim visuals, unrealistic skin texture, oversaturated colors
compliance_guardrails: 避免医疗、治疗、修复屏障等不可验证功效暗示
避免前后对比图与绝对化视觉表达
避免出现临床、处方、药妆等暗示性元素

prompts.goal: 建立高端第一印象并快速传达核心卖点
prompts.prompt: Create a premium skincare hero banner for a face oil bottle. Show the product floating at the center against a creamy white to soft champagne gradient background. Add subtle glossy oil droplets and elegant glass reflections to suggest lightweight nourishment. Use soft diffused studio lighting, minimal luxury composition, realistic packaging, sharp label, refined glow, editorial beauty advertising style, high-end ecommerce visual, clean negative space for headline placement.
prompts.negative_prompt: distorted bottle, unreadable label, cluttered props, dark background, dramatic hard light, medical icons, before-after effect, excessive sparkles

prompts.goal: 解释产品核心成分与使用收益
prompts.prompt: Design a premium skincare feature highlights image for a face oil. Use a clean split-panel composition with ingredient-inspired visuals for squalane, jojoba seed oil, and vitamin E. Include translucent oil textures, soft botanical cues, macro beauty details, and an elegant close-up of the product bottle. Keep the palette in warm beige, ivory, and subtle gold. The image should feel modern, minimal, informative, and commercial, suitable for an ecommerce A+ detail page.
prompts.negative_prompt: scientific lab scene, medical packaging, cluttered infographic, too many colors, fake fruit explosion, cartoon icons, distorted text area

prompts.goal: 展示妆前与夜间护理场景，增强用户代入感
prompts.prompt: Create a lifestyle storytelling image for a premium face oil, using a diptych composition. On the left, show a bright morning vanity or bathroom counter scene with soft natural light, suggesting pre-makeup skincare. On the right, show a warm nighttime bedside skincare scene with calm, intimate lighting. Place the product as a visual anchor between the two scenes. Keep styling elegant, feminine, minimal, and premium, with realistic product placement and ecommerce-friendly cleanliness.
prompts.negative_prompt: busy room, too many props, strong fashion makeup look, unrealistic skin glow, medical context, dark moody shadows, chaotic split layout

prompts.goal: 补充产品规格与购买决策信息
prompts.prompt: Generate a minimal premium skincare specification panel showing a face oil bottle with clean ecommerce infographic styling. Use a soft beige or ivory background, modern simple icons, tidy spacing, and a trustworthy design language. Emphasize product size, packaging clarity, and practical usage details. Keep the composition elegant, sparse, and easy to read, with the bottle rendered sharply and proportionally.
prompts.negative_prompt: crowded layout, cheap graphic style, neon colors, blurry bottle, excessive text, fake certification badges, medical symbols
